# The pin's repository JSON files whose text holds an absolute path of two or more segments, as a whole token: any
# builder's machine places are such paths (Workshop's /home and /tmp, a cloud box's /workspace, a Mac's /Users).
# They are the corpus product's only declared repository JSON: buildcache's relocation check passes such a path only
# when a declared tracked file holds it (#arw7837), and no other JSON file enters the product's key (#gskb0x3).
# TestJSONCorpusVouchingIsExact holds this list to the pinned corpus; a new pin regenerates it.
